numbers.caption: Nine are within ΔE 6.0 of a neighbor. Nobody can tell them apart.
Two sit off the 4 px grid: 10 and 18, on 12 pages.

drift.narrative: The palette carries 14 grays where nine would do, and nine of them sit within ΔE 6.0 of a neighbor. Two spacing values, 10 and 18, sit off the 4 px grid, on 12 pages. Three type styles differ by 1 px or less in size or line height. The proposed set folds the grays into nine steps, maps the off-grid values to their nearest steps and merges the near-duplicate type styles into eight. Every pair of text and background keeps its contrast ratio.

exports.designSystemIntro: This design system was extracted from localhost:4100 across 12 pages. It holds 23 colors, nine type styles, 11 spacing steps and 31 components.
